description: A shell script for testing Git's read-tree command in various scenarios, including two-tree and three-tree configurations, handling ignored files, untracked files, symlinks, and D/F (directory/file) conflicts.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with a descriptive name.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_succeed
methods.description: Executes the read_tree command expecting it to succeed, failing the test otherwise.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_fail
methods.description: Executes the read_tree command expecting it to fail, passing the test if it does.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Marks a test case that should fail.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Defines cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: test_ln_s_add
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link and adds it to Git.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock for Git tests, used for timestamp purposes.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares files or outputs as part of verification.
